Garen.summary: Garen wins extended trades when he can stay in your face. Respect his passive regen out of combat and his E (Judgment) damage ramp.

counter_picks.reason: True damage and kiting punish Garen when he commits with Q. Tumble dodges his silence.
Blind and vault keep Garen from ever reaching you. Harass with W passive procs.
Blind stops his Q+AA trade pattern. Shroom slow zones deny all-in after level 6.
Range advantage and scaling. Slow with W to kite his E spin window.
Extended trades favor Darius if you dodge Q edge. Garen cannot disengage once hooked.

ability_tips.name: Perseverance
ability_tips.tip: Garen regens heavily when he hasn't taken damage recently. Poke him constantly — even small damage stops the regen for several seconds.

ability_tips.name: Decisive Strike
ability_tips.tip: Point-and-click speed boost + silence + empowered auto. If he runs at you with Q active, sidestep or disengage before the silence lands. It removes your ability to flash/dash for ~1.5s.

ability_tips.name: Courage
ability_tips.tip: Passive armor/MR stacking and active damage reduction. Extended fights make him tankier. Burst before W active or bait the W then re-engage after it ends.

ability_tips.name: Judgment
ability_tips.tip: THE KEY ABILITY. Garen spins (E) dealing physical damage per tick. Damage INCREASES the longer he stays on one target (up to 10 stacks). Never stand inside the spin — walk out immediately or he out-trades you. Only 1 tick hits if you leave quickly.

ability_tips.name: Demacian Justice
ability_tips.tip: Execute based on missing HP. Below ~40% HP you're in kill range. Don't stay low around him — recall or heal before he can flash-R.

laning_tips: Trade when his Q is on cooldown — without Q he has no gap close.
If he starts E (spin), walk OUT of the circle immediately. One tick is fine; 10 ticks loses the trade.
Bait his W damage reduction, then re-engage when it's on cooldown.
Buy anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Bramble Vest) to reduce passive regen value.
Garen has no escape — jungler ganks are very effective if he pushes.
power_spikes: Level 6: Execute ult makes all-ins deadly
First item spike (Stridebreaker/Black Cleaver): Strong duelist
items_to_consider: Plated Steelcaps / Merc Treads — reduces spin and ult damage
Bramble Vest / Thornmail — cuts passive regen
Phage / Stridebreaker — if you're a bruiser who needs to stick

Darius.summary: Darius wins long trades with passive stacks and Q heal on the blade edge. Never fight him at 5 Hemorrhage stacks.

counter_picks.reason: Kites him endlessly. Vault denies Apprehend (E).
Condemn stops his engage. True damage ignores his tankiness.
Blind stops W reset auto. Range keeps you out of Q edge.
Outscales and kites. Slow prevents stack buildup.
Mega form CC and hop disengage. Mini form harass.

ability_tips.name: Hemorrhage
ability_tips.tip: Each ability/auto applies a stack. At 5 stacks he gets massive AD. Reset stacks by leaving combat or killing minions without fighting him.

ability_tips.name: Decimate
ability_tips.tip: Outer edge heals him and deals more damage. Stand INSIDE the handle (close range) for reduced damage and no heal — or stay far away entirely.

ability_tips.name: Crippling Strike
ability_tips.tip: Next auto is a slow + armor shred. After he uses an ability, his next AA applies slow — respect the reset timing.

ability_tips.name: Apprehend
ability_tips.tip: Pull + slow. 24s cooldown early. Bait it out, then trade while it's down. Don't dash toward him when E is up.

ability_tips.name: Noxian Guillotine
ability_tips.tip: Resets on kill. Never stay execute range with 5 stacks — he will flash-R and snowball.

laning_tips: Short trades only — never let him reach 5 passive stacks.
Stand in the inner ring of his Q or dodge the blade entirely.
Punish when Apprehend (E) is on cooldown.
Buy early boots — his win condition is sticking to you.
Call jungler when he pushes — immobile and easy to gank.

Yasuo.summary: Yasuo scales with tornado setups and wind wall. Don't fight in minion waves — he will dash through them endlessly.

counter_picks.reason: Point-and-click stun ignores wind wall. Burst before he scales.
Suppression can't be wind-walled. Passive blocks poke.
Early all-in before Yasuo scales. W breaks shield.
Point-and-click W stun. Strong early game.
Q silence stops dash chains. Simple kit beats mechanics.

ability_tips.name: Way of the Wanderer
ability_tips.tip: Shield from moving. Break it with any damage before trading. Double crit passive makes him scale hard.

ability_tips.name: Steel Tempest
ability_tips.tip: Third Q is a tornado knockup. Watch his stacks — when whirlwind is ready, play safe. He can EQ-flash for surprise knockups.

ability_tips.name: Wind Wall
ability_tips.tip: Blocks ALL projectiles for 4 seconds. Don't waste key abilities into it. Bait it out then fight.

ability_tips.name: Sweeping Blade
ability_tips.tip: Dashes through targets. Cooldown per target. In a big minion wave he has many dashes — don't chase in waves.

ability_tips.name: Last Breath
ability_tips.tip: Only usable on knocked-up enemies. If no tornado ready, his all-in is much weaker.

laning_tips: Trade when shield is down and tornado (3rd Q) is on cooldown.
Freeze near your tower — long lane makes him overextend for dashes.
Don't fight in large minion waves.
Wind wall has a long cooldown early — punish after he uses it.
Buy early armor — he deals mostly physical damage.

Lux.summary: Lux is a long-range mage. She wins by landing Q (binding) into full combo. Respect her range and bush control.

counter_picks.reason: Wind wall blocks Q and R. Dash through minions to gap close.
All-in after she uses Q. R dodges her burst.
E dodges all skillshots. Gap close with R.
Can steal her R. Survives burst with W heal.
Scales into her. R gap close after level 6.

ability_tips.name: Illumination
ability_tips.tip: Abilities mark targets. Auto-attack detonates for bonus damage. After she hits a spell, expect an AA for extra poke.

ability_tips.name: Light Binding
ability_tips.tip: Roots up to 2 targets. 11s cooldown at rank 1. Sidestep or hide behind minions. If Q misses, she's vulnerable.

ability_tips.name: Prismatic Barrier
ability_tips.tip: Shield boomerang. Don't waste damage into the returning shield.

ability_tips.name: Lucent Singularity
ability_tips.tip: Slow zone + detonate. She often E then Q on slowed target. Move unpredictably.

ability_tips.name: Final Spark
ability_tips.tip: Global-range laser. Low cooldown late game. Don't stand in minion line or at low HP in her vision.

laning_tips: Hide behind minions to block Q.
All-in when Q is on cooldown.
Buy Boots early — dodge skillshots easier.
Bush control denies free Q setups.
Hexdrinker/Maw if AD assassin.

Zed.summary: Zed wins short burst windows with R. After he uses W/R, his threat drops massively for 20+ seconds.

counter_picks.reason: Point-and-click ult stops Zed. Shield blocks burst.
Self-R or W-R stops his all-in. Point-and-click CC.
Stun combo before he can R out. Point-and-click.
W magic shield. R for roams. CC stops assassination.
Pool dodges R pop. Outscales and sustains.

ability_tips.name: Contempt for the Weak
ability_tips.tip: Auto does bonus damage to low HP targets. Don't stay below ~50% HP in lane without vision.

ability_tips.name: Razor Shuriken
ability_tips.tip: Line skillshot. Stand behind minions. Hit from both shadow and body hurts a lot.

ability_tips.name: Living Shadow
ability_tips.tip: Shadow swap for escape or double Q. 20s cooldown. After W+R combo, punish hard — he's nearly harmless.

ability_tips.name: Shadow Slash
ability_tips.tip: Slow in melee range. Don't let him E slow then auto for passive proc.

ability_tips.name: Death Mark
ability_tips.tip: Untargetable dash to target. Mark detonates for stored damage. Zhonya's/Stasis dodges pop. After R ends, he MUST W back or die — track shadow location.

laning_tips: Buy Seeker's Armguard first back.
Stand in minion wave to block Q.
Trade aggressively after he uses W (20s window).
Zhonya's Hourglass hard counters his R.
Ward side bushes — Zed roams through fog.

Ahri.summary: Ahri wins with charm (E) into full combo. Without charm, her damage is much lower. Respect her roams.

counter_picks.reason: Wind wall blocks charm and R damage.
All-in before she gets items. R dodges charm combo.
Scales past her. R dodges charm.
Pool dodges charm. Outscales in sidelane.
Long range trade. Stun before she can charm.

ability_tips.name: Essence Theft
ability_tips.tip: Spells on champions give her a heal when she has 3 stacks. Short trades prevent healing.

ability_tips.name: Orb of Deception
ability_tips.tip: Returns for true damage. Dodge the return path — it hurts more than the initial hit.

ability_tips.name: Fox-Fire
ability_tips.tip: Auto-target flames. Used in all-in after charm. Less threatening alone.

ability_tips.name: Charm
ability_tips.tip: THE KEY ABILITY. 12s cooldown early. If charm misses, punish hard. Sidestep or hide behind minions.

ability_tips.name: Spirit Rush
ability_tips.tip: 3 dashes with damage. She uses this to finish or escape. After 3 dashes used, she's much weaker.

laning_tips: Dodge charm — matchup becomes easy if E misses.
Short trades, don't give 3 passive stacks.
Push and roam with her — match roams or ping missing.
Buy Merc Treads to reduce charm duration.
She is squishy — all-in when R dashes are down.

Mordekaiser.summary: Morde wins extended fights in his W heal zone and R 1v1. Don't get isolated or dragged into Death Realm.

counter_picks.reason: True damage % HP. Kites outside his E range.
Kite in mini, CC in mega. Never get R'd alone.
Vault denies E pull. Blind stops Q auto.
Parry denies key abilities. Outscales in duels.
R ignores Morde R. All-in early before he scales.

ability_tips.name: Darkness Rise
ability_tips.tip: 3 spells/AA on champions = AoE magic damage aura. Don't stand in extended trades at 3 stacks.

ability_tips.name: Obliterate
ability_tips.tip: Sweet spot at tip deals bonus damage. Sidestep or stay close inside the sweet spot edge.

ability_tips.name: Indestructible
ability_tips.tip: Stores damage as shield, then heals. DON'T attack during shield — you're feeding his heal. Burst when shield expires or ignore and disengage.

ability_tips.name: Death's Grasp
ability_tips.tip: Pull + magic penetration. 18s cooldown. Stay out of range or bait it then trade.

ability_tips.name: Realm of Death
ability_tips.tip: 1v1 arena. Steals stats. NEVER get caught alone. Buy QSS/Mercurial if ADC. Group vs him late.

laning_tips: Short trades — don't feed W shield with sustained damage.
Bait E pull, punish on cooldown.
Morde has no escape — gank when pushed.
Buy Merc Treads for magic damage.
Never fight alone when his R is up.

Sett.summary: Sett wins extended brawls with W true damage center and R front-to-back slam. Kite and don't stand in W sweet spot.

counter_picks.reason: Kites the bruiser. True damage % HP.
Never lets Sett reach you. Blind stops W trade.
Disengage with E hop. Mega CC.
Range and scaling. Slow prevents engage.
Blind stops empowered W. Shrooms slow chase.

ability_tips.name: Pit Grit
ability_tips.tip: Regen between punches. Right-left combo. Extended autos heal him — burst instead of long auto trades.

ability_tips.name: Knuckle Down
ability_tips.tip: Speed toward enemies + bonus damage on next 2 autos. Don't let him run you down with Q active.

ability_tips.name: Haymaker
ability_tips.tip: THE KEY ABILITY. Absorbs damage as grit, then punches for true damage in CENTER. Side-step or dodge the center line — edges only do physical. Never stand still in front of him when W is charging.

ability_tips.name: Facebreaker
ability_tips.tip: Pull if enemies on both sides. Don't stand between Sett and a minion/champion. Stun if pulled.

ability_tips.name: The Show Stopper
ability_tips.tip: Grabs frontline, slams behind. Don't stand in front of your carries. Sett wants to R a tank onto your backline.

laning_tips: Sidestep W center — it's true damage.
Kite with range — he has no gap close without Flash+Q.
Don't stand between him and another target for E stun.
All-in when W is down.
Gank when he pushes — immobile.

Thresh.summary: Thresh wins with hook (Q) pick potential and peel. Respect bush hooks and lantern saves.

counter_picks.reason: Black Shield blocks hook and flay. Binding outranges hook.
Spell shield blocks hook entirely.
E blink dodges hook. Safe poke from range.
Engage or peel. Can headbutt Thresh under tower.
Hard engage before hook lands. Tank hook with W.

ability_tips.name: Death Sentence
ability_tips.tip: Hook — 20s cooldown early. Hide behind minions. If hook misses, punish for 20 seconds. Thresh is nearly harmless without Q.

ability_tips.name: Dark Passage
ability_tips.tip: Lantern save. Focus lantern with clicks or stand on it to block. ADC can escape ganks with it.

ability_tips.name: Flay
ability_tips.tip: Knockback/pull. Can flay you into hook range. Don't walk up when Q is available.

ability_tips.name: The Box
ability_tips.tip: Slows and damages on wall break. Don't chase through walls. Walk around or wait it out.

laning_tips: Always stand behind minions vs hook.
Punish every missed hook — 20s window.
Click lantern to destroy it if ADC tries to escape.
Don't facecheck unwarded bushes.
Morgana/Sivir hard counter in champ select.

Jinx.summary: Jinx scales with rockets and passive resets. Punish her early weakness and CC her during passive move speed.

counter_picks.reason: Dominates early lane. Snowball before Jinx scales.
Burst and mobility. Strong early all-in.
Hard CC stops passive resets.
Point-and-click CC. Hook catches immobile Jinx.
Assassinate in teamfights. Jinx has no escape.

ability_tips.name: Get Excited!
ability_tips.tip: Kill/assist/tower = massive move speed. Don't chase after takedowns — she will outrun you. CC immediately on takedown.

ability_tips.name: Switcheroo!
ability_tips.tip: Fishbones (rockets) = AoE range but mana cost. Pow-Pow = single target DPS. Harass when on Pow-Pow, she has less range.

ability_tips.name: Zap!
ability_tips.tip: Long range slow skillshot. 8s cooldown. Sidestep or hide behind minions.

ability_tips.name: Flame Chompers!
ability_tips.tip: Traps root on contact. Don't walk in straight lines. Predictable paths get rooted.

ability_tips.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
ability_tips.tip: Global execute damage. Recall at low HP. It executes across the map.

laning_tips: All-in early — she's weak levels 1-3.
Stand behind minions for W and R.
CC stops passive move speed in fights.
Deny farm — she needs items to come online.
Naut/Leona hard engage before she scales.
